verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API whose root resource links to all other resources and returns account details, plus an account-export endpoint, so an agent can pull account and audience data programmatically. The evidence does not show API endpoints that list live automations or return per-campaign report metrics. Open/click reporting and Analytics AI's 'what's working' explanations are documented only as in-product features, not as agent-readable API data. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for listing automations and their status, API access to campaign report metrics (opens/clicks/revenue), an agent-facing reporting path, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: The API root resource links to all other resources available in the API. Calling the root directory also returns details about the Mailchimp user account.
Generate a new account export or download a finished account export.
Create a new omni-channel contact for an audience.
